p. 1 maximum ratings (MMBT2222L): VCEO 30 V, VCBO 60 V, VEBO 5.0 V, IC 600 mA; PD 225 mW on FR-5, RθJA 556 °C/W; TJ −55 … +150 °C; SOT-23 case 318 style 6: 1 base, 2 emitter, 3 collector

hfe_min 50: the minimum at IC = 1 mA, the current of ADLSC's gate driver; hfe_max 300: the maximum at 150 mA (the only maximum given)
pins: EasyEDA symbol of C43496 (edakit part import) = the data sheet's style 6
spice: assumption – a generic small-signal NPN, no manufacturer model read; BF = hFE min at 150 mA
notes: The schematic's 'MMBT2222': onsemi's MMBT2222LT1G (the plain MMBT2222, not the A version). It pulls the gates of Q2 and Q4 low from POWER_ON.
